batch: Tier 3 Crypto APIs — A+ upgraded (discovery schemas, execution gates, reasoning objects, structured chain_to, latency metadata)
improvements_applied: 1. Discovery endpoints have full explicit schemas with execution_modes
2. /lookup on Scalping, Breakout, Whale Entry: x-execution-gate-required + x-human-approval-required = true
3. reasoning object (why_signal_generated, key_factors, invalidators) on all execution-critical /lookup responses
4. chain_to upgraded from string[] to [{api, reason}] objects
5. x-latency-tier added to all APIs (real-time: Ticker, Breakout, Whale, Scalping; near-real-time: OHLCV, RSI, MACD, BB)
